flow_ref: User story (not in a flow deck OCMS)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/System/list/{StandardCodeList,RuleCodeList}.tsx, pages/System/form/{StandardCodeForm,RuleCodeForm}.tsx, App.tsx (route), utils/Meta/System.ts; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/{standardcode/StandardCodeController, offencerulecode/OffenceRuleCodeController}, resources/api-authorization.properties. Layar ini mengelola code internal URA (Standard Code, Offence Rule Code), bukan Master/Offence code dari State Courts. Menu Court Code hanya stub; tidak ada interface court yang bisa gagal.
note: The story status in the sheet is blank (requirement not given), traced normally. The staff portal has maintenance screens for Standard Code (search by reference code, list, Create, Edit description/status) and Offence Rule Code (search, list, Create, Edit), with server endpoints and the authorization mappings OCMS_SYSTEM_STANDARDCODE / OCMS_SYSTEM_RULE_CODE. This is a generic mechanism for internal URA codes, not Master/Offence codes from State Courts (no court column or source), so browse/modify is counted Sebagian only. The 'Court Code' menu in System.ts is only a stub with no route. Because the interface that receives codes does not exist (OCMS26.12), the 'fallback when the interface update fails' has no trigger. Editing Standard Code only changes description and codeStatus; the key (reference_code, code) cannot be changed. Per-role permissions in the database cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially only: generic maintenance screens for Standard Code and Offence Rule Code exist, but they are not State Courts codes. The Court Code menu and the fallback for interface failure are not built. Ask URA whether Standard Code/Offence Rule Code count as the intended 'Master and Offence codes'.

steps.step: The Court Processing Officer opens the code screen and browses the Master code list
steps.detail: A Standard Code screen exists (route App.tsx:403): Reference Code filter (StandardCodeList.tsx:143), Search/View All buttons, columns Reference Code, Standard Code, Description, Active/Defunct (:283-298). Server: mapping OCMS_SYSTEM_STANDARDCODE (api-authorization.properties:169-170). This lists internal URA codes, not State Courts Master codes: there is no court column/source, so only Sebagian.

steps.step: The Court Processing Officer browses the Offence code list
steps.detail: An Offence Rule Code screen exists (route App.tsx:428): search by vehicle category, computer rule code, offence type, composition amount, rule no, complaint code (RuleCodeList.tsx:142-195) and a grid with effective start/end date, status (:244-290). Server: mapping OCMS_SYSTEM_RULE_CODE (api-authorization.properties:176-178). It holds URA rule codes and composition amounts, not State Courts Offence codes, so Sebagian. Same as step 1 (consistent).

steps.step: The Court Processing Officer modifies a Master code when required
steps.detail: The Edit (StandardCodeList.tsx:307) and Create (:380) buttons call POST /standardcodepatch/{id1}/{id2} (StandardCodeController.java:100) and POST /standardcode (:52). Edit only allows description and codeStatus (PATCH_ALLOWED_FIELDS, :94); the key cannot be changed. Manual edit exists, but for internal URA codes, not State Courts codes. Role restriction in the DB cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: The Court Processing Officer modifies an Offence code when required
steps.detail: The Edit (RuleCodeList.tsx:307) and Create (:364) buttons call POST /offencerulecodepatch/{computerRuleCode}/{effectiveStartDate}/{vehicleCategory}/{compositionAmount} (OffenceRuleCodeController.java:103) and POST /offencerulecode (:53). Editable fields: complaintCode, description, effectiveEndDate, offenceType, ruleNo, secondaryFineAmount (:95-98). It exists for URA rule codes, not State Courts Offence codes.

steps.step: A dedicated Court Code menu for State Courts codes is available in the staff portal
steps.detail: The 'Court Code' menu is only registered in metadata: COURT_CODE: null (System.ts:62) and a label with null path (:187). There is no route in App.tsx, page, form, or authorization mapping/endpoint for court codes in ocmsadminapi. Synonyms tried: court code, courtcode, master code, state court in ocmsadminui and ocmsadminapi.

steps.step: Manual edit is available as a fallback when the code update through the interface fails
steps.detail: There is no State Courts code update interface (see OCMS26.12), so there is no detection or notification of an update failure and no link from a failure to the edit screen. Manual edit can be done at any time on Standard Code/Offence Rule Code (steps 3-4), but it does not act as a fallback for any interface. Synonyms tried: failure, retry, reject, interface error, sync status in ocmsadminprivateapi and ocmsadminui.
